Cookie Policy

Browser storage and third-party connections on the Penida studio website.

Last updated: September 23, 2026

Contents

  • 1. Browsing this website
  • 2. Orka support chat
  • 3. Your choices
  • 4. Contact and changes

1. Browsing this website

The site’s navigation, animations and locally hosted images and fonts do not require advertising or analytics cookies. This version does not include an advertising pixel or an audience-measurement script.

The website host can process technical network information to serve pages and protect infrastructure. This is distinct from advertising tracking in your browser.

2. Orka support chat

The Orka support widget loads automatically when you visit a page. This connects your browser to Orka before you open a conversation. Orka can process technical connection information and use browser storage or session identifiers to operate the widget and maintain conversation context.

Messages and any details you submit are sent when you use the chat. Closing the window hides it but does not delete its conversation or stored data. For conversation deletion requests, contact penidastudio@gmail.com. See Orka’s Privacy Policy for the service’s handling of personal data.

3. Your choices

You can use email to reach us. Choosing not to open a conversation does not prevent the widget from loading. Your browser settings let you inspect, restrict and remove stored site data; content-blocking settings can also restrict third-party connections. Blocking storage can affect the chat.

Linked websites, including Shopify and product websites, have their own cookie practices.

4. Contact and changes

For questions about this notice, contact PENIDA at penidastudio@gmail.com or 14 rue Charles V, 75004 Paris, France. We will update this notice if additional storage or tracking features are introduced.
